company.name: JD Logistics
company.shortDescription: JD Logistics is a supply chain solutions provider focused on warehousing, express, oversized, cold chain, and cross-border services.
company.description: JD Logistics is a technology-driven supply chain solution and logistics service provider in China. Jingdong Group began to build its own logistics in 2007, and officially established Jingdong Logistics Group on April 25, 2007. With the mission of "technology-driven, leading global efficient circulation and sustainable development", JD Logistics is committed to becoming the world's most reliable supply chain infrastructure service provider.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,500,000,000 to $13,500,000,000, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
